lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person feminine singular passive perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: كُشِطَتْ is in the derivative form: كُشِطَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ك/ش/ط   k–sh–ṭ to peel away, to peel off, to flay, to scratch off. Of this root, كُشِطَت kushiṭat occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
كُشِطَ kushiṭa [pass. v.] to be peeled off, to be stripped off, to be peeled away

(81:11) وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ when the sky is peeled away.
